title: Cerebral Reorganization of Stroke Patients After Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation by Neuroimaging Analysis
brief_summary: The study aimed to figure out brain structural and functional reorganization evidence after repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation through the method of neuroimaging brain network analysis, such as resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging and diffusion tensor imaging.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. stroke patients within 1 week after onset with unilateral cerebral subcortex lesion in the middle cerebral artery territory detected by diffusion weighted image,
2. right-handed,
3. without memory loss or intelligence disorder,
4. never suffered stroke before.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. direct damage to the cerebral cortex,
2. a history of cerebral vessel disease,
3. tendency to hemorrhage or existed brain hemorrhage,
4. epilepsy or other mental disorders,
5. any MRI contraindications.
